title: Does Mapo Tofu Contain Coffee? Probing LLMs for Food-related Cultural Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Probing LLMs to predict ingredients of dishes from various countries using a custom dataset (FMLAMA) and evaluating performance disparities across different cultural groups using Mean Average Precision (mAP) and Mean Word Similarity (mWS).

Evaluating model performance on cultural knowledge retrieval across six different prompt languages and code-switched settings to observe how the instruction language affects the accuracy and accessibility of culture-specific facts.
